question: The length of the tangent drawn from a point 10 cm away from the centre of a circle with radius 4 cm, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Length of tangent = √(Distance from centre² − Radius²)

Tangent length = √(10² − 4²)

Tangent length = √(100 − 16) = √84

Tangent length = 2√21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2√21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance of the point from the centre of the circle (d) = 10 cm

Radius of the circle (r) = 4 cm

**Formula Used:**

Pythagoras Theorem: (Hypotenuse)² = (Base)² + (Perpendicular)²
